content.overview: The patient was diagnosed with Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus on March 10, 2025, and initiated on dual oral hypoglycemic therapy with Empagliflozin and Metformin ER. Subsequent laboratory results on September 15, 2026, indicated elevated HbA1c, Fasting Blood Glucose, Total Cholesterol, LDL Cholesterol, and Triglycerides, while renal function and electrolytes remained within normal limits.

medications.name: Metformin ER
medications.summary: Prescribed on March 10, 2025, at a dosage of 500 mg twice daily for Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus.

healthcareJourney.summary: A prescription refill and regimen adjustment for dual oral hypoglycemic therapy was provided by Dr. Sarah Jenkins, MD, at Meridian Medical Centre, for Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus. Medications included Empagliflozin 10 mg and Metformin ER 500 mg.

Laboratory tests were ordered by Dr. Robert Vance, MD, and processed at MERIDIAN DIAGNOSTIC LABORATORIES. Results included elevated HbA1c (7.4%), Fasting Blood Glucose (138 mg/dL), Total Cholesterol (210 mg/dL), LDL Cholesterol (128 mg/dL), and Triglycerides (165 mg/dL).
